title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 207 ]

blocks.text: The job of Congress is to pass laws. Before a bill become a law, it must be approved by both houses of Congress and by the president. If the president rejects a bill, it can still become a law if the president's rejection is overpowered by at least a two-thirds majority of each house of Congress.
